name: Paris
notes:
LitArbi 0.9.46-beta “Paris” (build 50): LitArbi in Spanish and Russian.
• Two more languages for the whole app: Español and Русский. Choose one in Settings ▸ General ▸ Language (System, English, Deutsch, Français, Español, Русский); it applies the next time LitArbi starts.
• Citations, the List of Exhibits and bundles stay in the matter's convention language — a Spanish or Russian screen still cites “Exhibit C-1” in an ICC matter.
• Two new date styles: Spanish (5 de mayo de 2025) and Russian (5 мая 2025 г.).
• AI summaries can be written in Spanish or Russian.
• Ribbon buttons have more room for longer labels.
• Settings now appear fully in your language (some labels were still English in German and French too).
